title: Star Magic calls out bullying vs Cianne Dominguez, other 'PBB' housemates
summary: Star Magic took a stand against online bullying and harassment targeting “Pinoy Big Brother: Collab 3.0” housemates, particularly Cianne Dominguez and Shea Valerio, urging netizens to…

blocks.text: Star Magic took a stand against online bullying and harassment targeting “Pinoy Big Brother: Collab 3.0” housemates, particularly Cianne Dominguez and Shea Valerio, urging netizens to engage responsibly on social media. The talent management company issued a statement on Thursday, Nov. 5, appealing to fans to “make respect and kindness part of every conversation.” “Star Magic strongly condemns the online bullying, harassment, and personal attacks directed toward Cianne Dominguez, Shea Valerio and other ‘Pinoy Big Brother’ housemates,” it said. “While public opinions and criticisms are part of reality television, they should never be an excuse for hate or cruelty,” it stressed.
